skin.name: default
skin.description: Default v2 skin. Every state names one asset, and an asset name is the base name of a PNG under v2/assets/skin/src. Development loads those PNGs one by one; the release build packs exactly the ones referenced here into one sheet plus one map.

small.name: small
small.description: Compact uppercase 6 by 6 pixel font, the only font v2 draws with so far.

default.description: Dark inset panel used as the background of every container.
Standard dark push button with a centered label. Hover, pressed and disabled have no artwork of their own, so the renderer tints this background instead.

play.description: Transport play button. Grey while stopped, green while playing, with its own green hover artwork instead of a tint.

record.description: Record arm button. Red hover artwork, and red while recording.

default.description: A box that clips and scrolls its content. Drawn as an inset panel, like the containers it sits inside.

inset.description: A more recessed variant for a list or a grid sitting inside another panel.

default.description: An on/off box with its label beside it. The artwork is drawn at its natural size, so the insets do not apply; hover has no artwork of its own and is tinted.
Container for mutually exclusive choices. It draws no artwork of its own; itemStyle says which radioItem style its choices are drawn with.

buttons.description: The choices are drawn as a row of ordinary push buttons instead of the default blue-lit ones.

default.description: One choice in a radio group, drawn as a button that stays lit blue while selected.

button.description: A choice drawn exactly like a push button, lit green while selected. Used by the radioGroup "buttons" variant.

default.description: A horizontal track with a draggable thumb. The track is a recessed panel; thumbStyle names the button style the thumb itself is drawn with.
A numeric readout with a stepper column on its right. The readout is a recessed panel; thumbStyle names the button style the two stepper halves are drawn with.

big.description: A wider readout for a value that needs the room, such as the number of tracks.
